items.title: Offline SQL sync stack
items.oneliner: Offline-first sync engine pairs local SQLite with TypeScript and Rust cores, plus WebSocket transport and conformance tests.

items.title: Terminal code review workflow
items.oneliner: Terminal diff reviewer captures local sessions, adds annotations, and syncs GitHub pull request reviews without sending code elsewhere.

items.title: Linux desktop policy manager
items.oneliner: Open-source Linux policy manager now handles Thunderbird, Edge, and Firewalld with RBAC and a rebuilt web UI.

items.title: Progressive web components library
items.oneliner: 2.9 kB web components library loads HTML and CSS first, then adds accessible interactivity without framework lock-in.

items.title: Functional concurrency for Python
items.oneliner: Python library combines CSP-style concurrency with Maybe and Result types to simplify message passing and error handling.

items.title: Monitor silent file moves
items.oneliner: Practical shell walkthrough shows how watch plus progress exposes real-time status for mv and other quiet long-running commands.

items.title: Rust argument parsing library
items.oneliner: New Rust CLI parsing approach focuses on better UX and advanced argument handling for command-line tools.

items.title: Fast Android PDF reader
items.oneliner: Open-source Android PDF reader handles large files quickly, with bookmarks, highlights, notes, dark mode, and no ads.

items.title: Client-side 3D model diffing
items.oneliner: Browser tool compares STL, 3MF, and OBJ files locally, showing voxel diffs, volume changes, and tolerance shifts.

items.title: Cycloidal gearbox build repo
items.oneliner: Cloneable project includes Python-generated cycloidal gearbox designs, 3D-print files, and a working 1:9 NEMA 17 build.
